purpose: Provenance and limits for same-frame comparison of SDK hand meshes. No hardware or Unity interaction during this audit.

format.sourceLine: One based, sourceLineSHA256 covers original line bytes without the trailing newline. frame has exact decoded values from recorded source.
format.joints: 26 Oculus.Interaction.HandJointId poses from IHand.GetJointPose transformed from world into recordingOrigin space; position metrically meaningful under unit-scale origin, xyzw Unity quaternion relative to recordingOrigin.
format.wristPoses: 26 IHand.GetJointPosesFromWrist outputs in SDK wrist-relative space, pose.rotation xyzw. These are not raw tracking joint samples.
format.validity: Every selected hand: 26 valid, connected, tracked, fresh, wrist poses valid, finite components and unit quaternions to 1e-3. SteamVR confidence is derived from XR Hands pose validity.
format.upstream: SealXRHandsSource.Read calls XRHandJoint.TryGetPose for validity then discards pose; retains only tracking validity bits and observation times. SealLab.CaptureHand serializes SDK IHand output; cannot isolate raw tracker, local-axis mapping, or skin weight errors from these recordings alone.

pinchCheck.scope: 17 SealRecordings. Requires tracked, fresh, connected with thumb and index tip valid. Both measured in joints (recording origin space).
